title: RBI imposes monetary penalty on The Modern Co-operative Bank Limited, Chalisgaon, Maharashtra
description: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has, by an order dated June 23, 2026, imposed a monetary penalty of ₹1 lakh (Rupees One Lakh only) on The Modern Co-operative Bank Limited, Chalisgaon, Maharashtra (the bank) for non-compliance with certain directions issued by RBI on ‘Exposure Norms and Statutory / Other Restrictions – UCBs’ and ‘Know Your Customer (KYC)’. This penalty has been imposed in exercise of powers conferred on RBI under the provisions of Section 47A(1
